Subject: Re: {Case #8942} Request to retain traces for live-triage

Hi team,

We have a live customer-impacting issue in production that reproduces intermittently when certain inputs hit our pipeline. Our engineering lead is requesting a short window of data retention so they can repro and capture a root-cause trace. Per our contract we know data is deleted after 30 days, but we need a timeboxed exception of 48 hours for a narrow set of request IDs (I've attached a small sample and a checklist of what we'll capture).

Can Redwood make an exception and preserve the raw traces for request IDs listed in the attached log for a 48-hour window? We will not export any full payloads outside our org and will coordinate with your redaction guidance.

Thanks,
Sarah Jenkins
Sr. SRE, Sable Health

Attachments: sable-error-sample.log, triage-matters-checklist.pdf

Mina/Neha — forwarding Sable's ask. They need a 48-hour, request-ID-scoped retention carve-out to reproduce an intermittent P0. They promise no exports beyond screenshots and agree to follow our redaction checklist.

Key constraints we should consider:
- Minimal blast radius: scope to the explicit request IDs (attached).
- Timebox: exactly 48 hours; automated removal after window.
- Auditability: full audit log + access limited to SRE+Redwood triage engineer.

Priyom/Laura — please advise on ops steps and whether we need a legal/PR sign-off for this customer (Sable is a mid-market healthcare customer; there may be PHI concerns).

I think this is time-sensitive — they are currently throttling traffic to maintain availability. If we can approve this quickly we keep the customer from escalating.

Jonas

Redwood Inference

Jonas — thanks for the ping and Sarah for the clear ask. High level decision: security is OK to approve a 48-hour, request-ID-scoped retention carve-out under the following mandatory controls: 

1) Scope enforcement: Redwood ops will apply a retention override tag only to the explicit request IDs in Sable's attached list. No wildcard scoping.
2) Timebox automation: the override will automatically expire after 48 hours from activation; deletion will be triggered by our scheduled job and verified by ops.
3) Access control: only one designated Redwood triage engineer (TriageLead) and two named Sable SREs (per Sarah's list) will be granted temporary IAM roles with zero export rights. All access is read-only and session-recorded.
4) Redaction checklist: Sable must accept and acknowledge the redaction checklist in writing before we enable the override (screenshots allowed; full payload dumps are prohibited).
5) Audit and signoff: we will create a short incident binder and send a post-mortem snippet to Legal and Compliance within 48 hours of the window closing.

Operational notes for Priyom: set up a retention_override tag on the customer tenant with TTL 48h, create an audit ticket, and capture the deletion job run id. Use runbook HSB-9981 for the exact steps.

Neha — please confirm if we need an expedited Legal waiver given Sable's healthcare vertical. If Legal needs to sign, we should get an on-call counsel quick approval (email confirmation is fine).

I will stand by to approve once Priyom confirms the ops mechanics.

Mina Haddad
Head, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

All,

I performed a quick run-through against runbook HSB-9981 and can confirm we can implement the controls Mina listed. Proposed ops steps (ETA ~30m to be runnable):

1) Ingest Sable's attached request IDs into the retention_override queue. We will validate IDs against logs to ensure exact matches.
2) Apply retention_override tag with TTL=48h and record the job id: job_rtt_20271211_331.
3) Provision a temporary read-only session for 'triage-jonas' (Redwood) and two sessions for the named Sable SREs. Sessions are time-limited to the same 48h window and will be session-recorded.
4) Kick off the scheduled deletion job at TTL expiry; the job will generate a signed proof-of-deletion artifact and we will attach that to the incident binder.

I will not enable anything until we have Sable's written ack on the redaction checklist and an on-call counsel email confirmation or explicit waiver.

Launching now would take ~30 minutes after acknowledgements — tagging and access provisioning automated.

Priyom
